checks.observation: Each case has no three-cover and exactly twelve four-covers, all containing its recorded common point and with union of size seven. Deleting the common point leaves triples on six points, so ambient triple codegree two gives 3m<=2*binom(6,2)=30 and m<=10. An additional direct check rejected all 72 eleven-member selections by a repeated ambient triple. This reproduces the exceptional correction, not the entire 5,576-case census.

checks.method: Read D16-I8-deletion-cover-reconstruction.md, Arbitrary exterior points are retained, The raw12 cases, and Transfer to fibre inequalities; reconstructed the set inclusions.
checks.observation: At least thirteen link triples remain, while two support points meet at most ten, so every ambient four-cover uses at least three support points. A cover with an exterior point contains a support three-cover, controlled by global triple codegree two; primitive internal four-covers are controlled by simplicity. When C3 is empty in the six exceptions, all actual covers are internal. The fibre inequality requires actual deleted-cone inclusion D_j subset D_i, not a comparison of deletion cardinalities, and uses only nonedges forced by a graph homomorphism.
checks.scope: Arbitrary-support cover transfer and fibre implication

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-outer-deletion-exclusion.md and independently enumerated its bounded nonnegative integer scalar relaxation.
checks.observation: The four surviving hub triples give actual anchors with N(Q_i)=15+E0-s_i. The complete link consumes 23 hub incidences, leaving S+2P+3T+4q<=37. Actual singleton classes give S<=32 and S<=30 if P>0. Under those constraints the maximum of 3S+4P+4T+4q is 103, attained in the relaxation at (S,P,T,q)=(29,4,0,0), below the required 104. The domain needs neither an exterior-support cutoff nor a neighbourhood upper bound.
checks.scope: Cap15 outer-deletion contradiction and its geometric premises

checks.method: Read EXTERNAL-H27-SCOPE-ADDENDUM-20261024.md and the preserved h27-readme.txt and h27-script.txt; recomputed the common-neighbourhood and A3 deficit formulas.
checks.observation: The README claims three archive-hash checks, while the inspected script visibly hashes assembled frontiers and invokes other checks without explicit compressed-archive hash comparisons. This inspection does not audit the invoked predicates or historical execution. With an intersecting cap h, the common bound is 68-h; for the fixed A3 mass 68, sum e_i=8h-204 and a_i>=136-5h. Thus h=27 yields neighbourhood 41 and fibre lower bound 1, whereas h=28 yields 40 and -4. Manuscript Section 2 and the superseding addendum disclose the material limit without claiming a new local proof of H27.
checks.scope: Corrected H27 source assurance and exact sensitivity

findings.disposition: Retain the explicit source-audit limitation in manuscript Section 2 and the superseding addendum. No counterexample to H27 follows from the inspection gap, but successful new local computations are not a substitute for this external theorem dependency.
findings.statement: H27 is an essential numerical import whose historical-source provenance has not been authenticated locally. The present proof is not robust to merely weakening the intersecting cap from 27 to 28.

revisions.action: Read the superseding H27 addendum and the fetched README and top-level script, then checked the numerical sensitivity of the H27 interface.
revisions.result: The import boundary is now more specific: archive authentication and source-to-historical-run identity were not established. The corrected manuscript exposes this limitation, and my earlier scoped approval of the import interface should not be read as authentication of the external computation.

content.summary: Independent bounded checks reproduce all six exceptional D16 cover corrections and the cap15 outer-deletion scalar contradiction. Their transfer to actual families preserves exterior completions, complete-link hypotheses and actual-anchor requirements. The revised H27 disclosure accurately identifies a material external provenance limitation; these local checks do not repair it. No further revision is requested in this round.
